• Tamarack Components newsletter: this week's topic is warehouse automation in 2026, linking to their blog article at blog.tamarack.example/2026/warehouse.
• Article ("Warehouse automation in 2026"): pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts, but integration took twice as long as planned.
• Companion piece (insights.tamarack.example/warehouse/companion): the biggest cost saving came from fewer mis-picks.
